notes.title: Hangry Early Access Release Sept 27th
notes.notes:
Time to book your table reservations. We are excited to announce that Hangry will be released on Early Access Saturday September 27th, 2025! It will release with a promo sale that will last for the duration of Steam's Autumn sale.



Plus with your main course, you get Hangry's first comic book "First Course" for FREE!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859093/f85ecc9eb4a65ced4446f6e5c9edbfca87393261.png"]



Learn about the origins of Hangry and how he joined Chef Goutra and got himself involved in the shady and delicious world the food underground.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859093/56dd71d3fbea3e892ccff1a4aee9e7a21683b316.png"]



Try out the DEMO which is available right now. You get access to the game's tutorial and first mission! You can continue your demo save file on the full game.



Add to your Wishlist today!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2601510/HANGRY/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Get the Hangry Comic Book "First Course" on Release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859093/f85ecc9eb4a65ced4446f6e5c9edbfca87393261.png

Available when the game releases, comes Hangry's first comic, "First Course"! Experience a moment in the blue hunter's history and how the ferocious creature met the up and coming chef, Goutra. Will be available as DLC.
